summary.en: Bitwise operators combine integer bit positions.
summary.bn: unsigned মানে mask দিয়ে bit set, clear, toggle ও check করো এবং shift-এর সীমা বোঝো।

notes: All six bitwise operators exist in C89. These examples use C17 and hexadecimal or decimal masks; binary 0b literals become standard in C23. C17 negative signed right shifts remain implementation-defined.

examples.title: Combine two bit patterns
examples.explanationHtml: The low-bit diagram predicts eight for AND, fourteen for OR and six for XOR. Check each output by lining up the two binary operands. The operators act on matching positions; they do not combine the decimal digits twelve and ten.

examples.title: Set, clear, toggle and test
examples.explanationHtml:
Starting from two, setting bit two gives six. Clearing the bit represented by two leaves four. Toggling bit two turns it off and leaves zero. The final check is false.

Following each stored update explains why the flag disappears.

examples.title: Limit complement to four bits
examples.explanationHtml: Ten has low bits 1010. Complementing and retaining four positions gives 0101, or five. A left shift gives twenty and a right shift gives five. All shift counts are one, safely below the unsigned int width.

examples.title: Parity and a distinct-object XOR swap
examples.explanationHtml: The low bit of five is one, indicating odd parity. Three separate XOR assignments exchange a and b. The objects are distinct, and each update completes before the next begins. This demonstrates the identity; a temporary variable would communicate the swap more directly.

practice.title: Read the low bit
practice.statementHtml: Read unsigned n 0 to 255. After the prompt Input: , print n & 1U and newline.

practice.title: Set bit two
practice.statementHtml: Read unsigned flags 0 to 15. After the prompt Input: , set bit two and print the result with newline.
hints: Setting an already-set bit leaves it set.

practice.title: Clear bit one
practice.statementHtml: Read unsigned flags 0 to 15. After the prompt Input: , clear bit one and print flags with newline.

practice.title: Toggle a selected low bit
practice.statementHtml: Read unsigned value 0 to 255 and position 0 to 7. After the prompt Input: , toggle that position and print the new value and whether that bit is now set, separated by a space and newline.
hints: Use a bounded unsigned shift to build the mask.

quiz.explanation: A one in the mask forces an OR result bit to one.

quiz.prompt: Which operation clears a selected bit?
quiz.explanation: Complement puts a zero at the selected position.

quiz.prompt: What does XOR with a one-bit mask do?
quiz.explanation: A differing mask bit reverses the input bit.

quiz.prompt: Which type is preferable for beginner bit shifts?
quiz.explanation: Unsigned shifts have clearer bit-filling and arithmetic rules.

quiz.prompt: Is shifting by the full operand width valid?
quiz.explanation: The count must be strictly less than the promoted type width.

options: Every bit of the promoted operand type
quiz.explanation: An explicit low-bit mask limits the displayed result.

quiz.prompt: Why is XOR swapping the same object twice unsafe?
quiz.explanation: The identity requires two distinct objects with their values preserved through the sequence.

quiz.prompt: Which low-bit intersection comes from 12 AND 10?
Toggling bit two of four produces which value?
quiz.explanation: The selected bit was set, so XOR clears it.

quiz.prompt: A masked complement keeps four bits. What result appears?
quiz.explanation: The four low bits of 1010 become 0101.

quiz.prompt: A mask selects position three. What unsigned value does 1U << 3 produce?
quiz.explanation: Positions count from zero, so position three has value eight.

quiz.prompt: What does (flags & mask) != 0U change compared with flags & mask?
options: It normalizes the intersection to a truth value
It forces both values to zero
quiz.explanation: The raw intersection may be a power of two; inequality produces int zero or one.

keyPoints.en: Bitwise operators combine integer bit positions.
keyPoints.bn: bitwise operator integer-এর প্রতিটি bit নিয়ে কাজ করে।

keyPoints.en: OR sets, AND with complement clears, and XOR toggles.
keyPoints.bn: OR দিয়ে set, complement mask দিয়ে AND করলে clear, XOR দিয়ে toggle হয়।

keyPoints.en: A bit mask names selected positions.
keyPoints.bn: mask দিয়ে কোন bit নিয়ে কাজ হবে তা বোঝানো হয়।
shift শেখার সময় unsigned operand ব্যবহার করো।

keyPoints.en: Shift counts must fit the promoted operand width.
keyPoints.bn: shift count operand-এর bit width-এর চেয়ে ছোট হতে হবে।

keyPoints.en: A temporary variable is clearer for ordinary swaps.
keyPoints.bn: সাধারণ swap-এ temporary variable বেশি পরিষ্কার।

examQuestions.question: Which operation sets selected bits?
examQuestions.answerHtml: OR with the mask. A one in the mask forces an OR result bit to one.

examQuestions.question: Which operation clears a selected bit?
examQuestions.answerHtml: AND with the complemented mask. Complement puts a zero at the selected position.

examQuestions.question: Read unsigned value 0 to 255 and position 0 to 7. After Input: toggle that position and print the new value and whether that bit is now set, separated by a space and newline.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    unsigned int value, position;
    printf("Input: ");
    if (scanf("%u %u", &value, &position) != 2 || value > 255U || position > 7U) {
        return 1;
    }
    unsigned int mask = 1U << position;
    value ^= mask;
    printf("%u %d\n", value, (value & mask) != 0U);
    return 0;
}

Use a bounded unsigned shift to build the mask.
